findings.title: Note under-reports 2D_Case_2R constraint.csv: it also sets voltage-dependent spacing and current-dependent width
findings.detail: Note §2 gives 2D_Case_2R's constraint.csv spacing as '0.5 everywhere'. The file at the pinned commit also has a 'Voltage Difference, Minimum Spacing' table (0 V→2, 5 kV→3, 10 kV→4, 15 kV→5 mm) and a 'Current Rating, Minimum Width' table (0→2 up to 15 A→3.5 mm). The 2R macro_script sets Reliability-awareness: 2, so these tables are active. Using the voltages the note itself cites (T10 15000, T2 7500, T1 0), the source's own rule requires about 3 mm or more for DC+/PHASE and PHASE/DC-, and about 5 mm for DC+/DC-. The reconstruction, and therefore the measured rules, have 2.0 mm for DC+/PHASE and PHASE/DC-. The gate copper is close to this limit too: T6 GATE_HS is at 7507.5 V and sits 2 mm from DC+ (15 kV). The measured rules still follow the objective's definition ('measured on the snapped reconstruction'), so the claim stands. The omission matters when the founder weighs the §6 rule options. On the positive side, T6 at 7507.5 V confirms the GATE_HS net assignment (gate referenced to PHASE).
findings.evidence: WebFetch of work/Sample_Designs/2D_Case_2R/constraint.csv @a1de7ced: 'Voltage Difference,Minimum Spacing / 0,2 / 5000,3 / 10000,4 / 15000,5'; 'Current Rating,Minimum Width / 0,2 / 5,2.5 / 10,3 / 15,3.5'; macro_script.txt 'Reliability-awareness: 2'. measured_rules spacing_dcp_phase 0.002, spacing_phase_dcm 0.001999999.
findings.suggested_check: Add the voltage/current tables to the note's [F] list and state that the reference itself does not meet them.

findings.title: §6 mechanism for 2D_Case_2R is wrong: the gate-foot repair runs and fails; it is not skipped
findings.detail: The note says 'The reference has signal wires, so the twin's gate-foot repair (step 3) does not apply, and any violation raises.' In twin.py, _repair_signal runs whenever spec.die.pads contains 'gate', which it does here (spec.die_pads_rel_centre_mm has 'gate'). I wrapped _repair_signal: it is called once on 2R and returns None. The repair moves the gate foot inside a 0.5 mm pad and shifts the power feet along u, and neither can add the 0.75 mm of gate-wire length needed. So the TwinError is real, but the stated reason is not.
findings.evidence: Scratch run: '2R rot=0: repair_called=1 repair_returned_None=[True] -> TwinError: the fitted twin is not DRC-clean ... signal wire 2 length 4.597e-03 m outside [5.344e-03, 1.040e-02] m'. twin.py lines 605-611 and 534-536.
findings.suggested_check: Rephrase: the step-3 repair was attempted and found no clean placement.

findings.title: Source ambiguity about ceramic thickness, and the 2R measure type, are not disclosed
findings.detail: 2D_Case_2R's macro_script uses Parasitic_model CU_200_380_200.rsmdl (a 0.38 mm ceramic response surface), while layer_stack.csv gives AlN 0.835 mm. 2D_Case_6 uses CU_200_630_200 against 0.64 mm. The reconstruction follows layer_stack.csv, which is defensible, but the conflict is not mentioned, and it affects absolute L_sub and thermal values. 2R's macro also has 'Measure_Type: 0', which the Case 6 file's comment defines as resistance, while Measure_Name says Inductance. Only the L5→L1 port pair is used, so the net assignment is unaffected.
findings.evidence: WebFetch of both macro_script.txt and layer_stack.csv files @a1de7ced.
findings.suggested_check: Add a [F] line recording the rsmdl-versus-layer_stack thickness mismatch and the choice made.

findings.title: Reference JSONs are not yet E008 admissibility records
findings.detail: E008.yaml admissibility_fields asks for sic_mosfet_half_bridge, separate_antiparallel_diode_dies, decided_at, the source of L_term_H, on_grid_0p5mm and the snapping-check values. The JSONs carry diode_dies: 0, on_grid_0p5, L_term_H without a source field, and no decided_at, and E008 config.references is still []. The claim lists no deliverables, so this is a follow-up, not a defect.
findings.suggested_check: Map the JSON fields to E008's admissibility_fields when the loader is added.

findings.title: --check verifies only the reconstruction hash against the JSON; the area check repeats hand-typed numbers from the same file
findings.detail: check() compares only reconstruction_hash with the committed JSON. Stale measured_rules, snap records or twin results would still pass. exp_area is typed by hand in the same REFS dict as the rectangles, so it guards against typos, not against mistranscription. I recomputed every JSON field independently (below) and found no drift today.
findings.suggested_check: Have --check diff the whole regenerated record (without the twin) against the JSON.

findings.title: The 2R TwinError does not depend on M1 (the note left this untested)
findings.detail: With M1 forced to 180°, 2R still raises TwinError, for a different reason: 'die at (15.00, 19.00) mm has 0 wires, spec says 1'. At 180° the LS power foot (y = 17.125) lies 0.025 mm outside the rotated source pad (y ≥ 17.15). So the 180° alternative was not even a valid placement, and the M1 score, which uses wire distances only, does not test that. The chosen 0° keeps every foot inside its source pad with at least 0.7 mm margin, so the frozen reconstruction is unaffected.
findings.evidence: Scratch run: '2R rot=180: fp=1ce573fa7bd0 sig_len_range_mm=[6.065, 9.761] -> TwinError: die at (15.00, 19.00) mm has 0 wires, spec says 1'.

Compared l2_unknowns() with l2_layout.build_layout_system (same lattice, LAYERS_TOP/BACK/BASE, build_filaments z_floor) and checked the lattice sizes against the baseplate outlines (55x60 → 220x240, 60x40 → 240x160 at 0.25 mm).
Confirmed that Layout.fingerprint covers stack, dies, pads, wires, terminals and signal wires, so reconstruction_hash freezes every modelled input; confirmed that K_LAWS has AlN and SAC305.
caveats: Source sha256 values were not re-hashed independently. The sandbox has no raw-byte network access, and WebFetch returns converted text. Only the content was verified, not the bytes.

The reconstructions are faithful to the source's numbers. Their electrical and thermal meaning is conditional on modelling choices M1-M10: uniform die orientation, 1.0 mm loop height, 50 µm attach, 1 µm solder placeholder, lead footprints as terminals, AlN 170 W/(m K).

The measured rules are geometric minima of the as-drawn layouts. For 2R they are looser than the source's own voltage-dependent spacing table (≥3 mm between power nets at 7.5 kV), which the reference itself does not meet.

As frozen, neither reference passes E008's twin construction (2R: signal-wire length; Case 6: no generator orientation/sequence fits). The reconstructions are usable as frozen geometry, but not yet as E008 judged references without a founder decision.
